title: Computing critical velocities in waveguides via multiparameter eigenvalue problems
summary: In waveguide dynamics and moving-load problems (e.g., high-speed trains), critical velocities indicate the onset of strong vibration amplification. In systems that are invariant in the direction of motion, these velocities can be identified from dispersion relations as points where the phase and group velocities of a propagating mode coincide. Finding such points indirectly by tracing dispersion curves can be cumbersome and potentially unreliable for multimodal systems with complex branch interactions. We present a direct method for computing critical velocities in such scenarios,…
